name: Carol Krucoff
reason: Health rule: her own site healingmoves.com (read 10 Nov 2026) frames her work as 'the powerful medicine of movement': yoga therapy sessions at Duke Integrative Medicine for people with health challenges, fitness writing and stress-relief books; her second site is yoga4seniors.com. Her work is mainly therapeutic and fitness-led rather than spiritual teaching, and little would pass the health-claim rule, so she is skipped. yoga4seniors.com was not fetched.
